direct_answer: Aker BP states it does not have a climate change mitigation transition plan that is in line with ESRS requirements, because it does not have targets to reduce Scope 3 emissions; it also states it does not have a timeline for if or when it will develop such a plan [Source 1]. Therefore, the undertaking does not disclose a 1.5°C-aligned transition plan under ESRS E1-1 [Source 1]. Separately, Aker BP discloses that its climate-related targets are not science-based [Source 6], which does not support demonstrating 1.5°C compatibility under ESRS E1-1/E1-4.
compliance_rationale: The company explicitly discloses that it does not have an ESRS-compliant climate transition plan and that it has no timeline to develop one [Source 1]. It also discloses its climate-related targets are not science-based [Source 6], and the provided passages do not include an explanation of compatibility with limiting warming to 1.5°C as required by ESRS E1-1.16(a) and E1-4.34(e).
disclosure_gaps: No ESRS E1-1 transition plan disclosure (content/structure of a mitigation transition plan) beyond stating it is not in place [Source 1].
No explanation of how GHG reduction targets are compatible with limiting global warming to 1.5°C (E1-1.16(a)) in the provided passages.
No timeline for adopting an ESRS-compliant transition plan (E1-1.17); company states it does not have a timeline [Source 1].

No disclosure of science-based target framework/methodology, underlying climate/policy scenarios used to set targets, or external assurance of targets as required by ESRS E1-4.34(e); company states targets are not science-based and not externally assured [Source 6].
key_findings: Aker BP states it does not have a climate transition plan in line with ESRS requirements and has no timeline to develop one [Source 1].
Aker BP states it has no targets to reduce Scope 3 emissions, which it links to the absence of an ESRS-compliant transition plan [Source 1].
Aker BP states its climate-related targets are not science-based and are not externally assured [Source 6].
